name: drug_repurposing
description: Find drug repurposing candidates for a disease using TXGNN model predictions from the data lake
usage: from app.tools.biomni.pharmacology import drug_repurposing; result = drug_repurposing('Alzheimer disease', top_k=20)

parameters.disease_name: str — name of the disease to find drug candidates for
parameters.top_k: int — number of top drug candidates to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: disease, candidates (list of {drug_name, score, mechanism})
